title: PRECAUTIONS
ocr_text:
PRECAUTIONS

1. Do not keep the ignition switch ON for more than 10 minutes if the engine will not start.

2. As some tachometers are not compatible with this ignition system, we recommend that you confirm the compatibility of your unit before using.

3. NEVER allow the ignition coil terminals to touch ground as it could result in damage to the igniter and/or the ignition coil.

4. Do not disconnect the battery when the engine is running.

5. Make sure that the igniter is properly grounded to the body.

6. When a tachometer is connected to the system, connect the tachometer positive terminal to the service connector.
